name: Snivy

atk.x: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

fl: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Maractus

atk.x: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

fl: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Tepig

atk.x: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

fl: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Oshawott

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

fl: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Alomomola
fl: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Blitzle

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

fl: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Munna

atk.x: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

fl: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Sandile

atk.x: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

fl: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Zorua

atk.x: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

fl: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Klink

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

fl: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Pidove

atk.x: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

fl: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Audino

atk.x: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

fl: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
